desc: Paper Mario 64 bosses in the story are optional fights, so Run Away works in them as in any ordinary battle (it was greyed out: the stage's entry, Lord Crump's, carried NPC_BATTLE_NO_ESCAPE). Mario with 50 coins walks into Jr. Troopa in the plaza, the auto battler runs away (the game's own gauge), he drops coins, he is back in the plaza with Jr. Troopa still standing there, not beaten; walking away and into him again is a second meeting and a second fight
